facts.position: At the center of the solar system
facts.mean_solar_distance_au: 0 AU (the reference point for solar distance)
facts.orbital_period_earth_days: About 225 million years around the center of the Milky Way
facts.rotation_period: About 25 days at the equator; the poles rotate more slowly
facts.axial_tilt: About 7.25 degrees relative to the plane of Earth's orbit
facts.atmosphere: Layers include the photosphere, chromosphere, and corona
facts.signature_fact: Nuclear fusion in its core converts hydrogen into helium and releases the light and heat that power life on Earth.

facts.position: Earth's natural satellite; Earth is the third planet from the Sun
facts.mean_solar_distance_au: About 0.00257 AU from Earth (384,400 km on average)
facts.rotation_period: 27.3 days; synchronous rotation keeps nearly the same side facing Earth
facts.axial_tilt: About 6.7 degrees relative to its orbital plane
facts.atmosphere: An extremely thin exosphere, not breathable air
facts.signature_fact: The Moon is slowly moving away from Earth, by about 3.8 centimeters each year.
